page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Below it, two parallel columns: Greek on the left, italic Latin with some Greek on the right. Below the columns, full-width roman Latin text with marginal notes in the left margin. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: τρίτου, τελευταῖοι δ' οἱ τὰ τέταρτου. πάλιν δ' ἄλλων τε-ταρῶν παραχθέντων, λαμβάνου-σι πρῶτοι τὴν αἵρεσιν οἱ τοῦ δευτέ-ρου στρατεύου, ὁ ἐξῆς, οὕτως. τε-λευταῖοι δ' οἱ ἔπειτα. μὴ ὁ [?] πάλιν ἄλλων τετάρτων προσαχθέν-των, πρῶτοι λαμβάνουσιν οἱ τρί-του στρατεύου, τελευταῖοι δ' οἱ τοῦ δευτέρου. καὶ ἀεὶ κατὰ λόγον οὕτως ἐν περιόδου τῆς ἐπιλογῆς γνομέ-νης, παραπλήσιους συμβαίνει λαμβάνειν ἑκάστῳ τῶν ἀνδρῶν ἐξ ἑκά-στου τῶν στρατευόντων.

p.i: tertiȳ Tertia; vltimi Quar-ta. Iterumque quattuor productis, primi electio-nem habent Secunda le-gionis Tribuni; & sic de-inceps: vltimi vero Prima. Post hæc denuò quattuor productis, primi capiunt Tertia legionis Tribuni, vltimi vero Secunda. At-que ita semper electione al-ternante & in orbem eun-te, fit vt pares admodum ca-piatur in quamq; legionem.

main_text.p: Iam sustine, & audi. Tribunos creauit, numerauit, de ætate & censu adiunxit: nunc denique Modum & formam exponit Dilectus.

„ Consules Dilectui praesunt, Tribuni eligunt. Consules diem publicè prodicunt.] Etsi enim Tribuni electi, tamen præcipua dilectuum Consules ipsi obeunt, & summæ rei præsident, Tribuni administrant & exsequuntur per partes. Polybius de rep. Romana, inter munia consularia hoc recenset, καταγεράφειν στρατιώτας καὶ ἀδρὰς ἐπιλέγειν. Cōscribere milites, & idoneos diligere.

Lib. iii. Liuius non semel narrat. vt: Consules positis sellis dilectum Sedent in curulibus. habebant. Vbi & aliquid de formâ: nam in curulibus suis sedebant, specie magistratus. Dionysius Lib. viii: Consules in subiecto campo curules sellas (τὰς στρατηγικὰς δίφρους) posuerunt, vbi & dilectum habuerunt. Vt nouum notat, quòd in campo: nam solent in Capitolio, vt iam diximus: sed eò factum, quò Tribunitiæ intercessiones vitarentur, quibus non ibi locus.

page.notes: Greek column: several words are uncertain, marked [?], notably the line ending "μὴ ὁ [?]" and the Greek in the Latin column near "καταγεράφειν" and "δίφρους", which are read from a cursive hand and may be inexact.
